bills-agent.description: The consumer delegates the month's bills to an agent that pays under a signed mandate: per-payment cap, monthly cap, named payees, expiry. Every payment returns a receipt.
next_steps: cp agents/bills-agent/.env.example agents/bills-agent/.env   # then fill in your keys

collections-agent.description: The merchant's agent that collects: agrees terms with the payer inside a negotiation envelope, issues one bolepix per instalment with an idempotency key, presents the QR and the copy-and-paste in the conversation, and closes the cycle on commerce.charge.paid or commerce.charge.expired.
next_steps: cp agents/collections-agent/.env.example agents/collections-agent/.env   # then fill in your keys
